_comment: Cutover smoke — the surfaces a staging promotion is most likely to break, driven in a real browser. Run BEFORE promoting (against local) and AFTER (against staging, via --base). Read every PNG: a 200 response proves the route resolved, not that the screen is usable. Usage: pnpm exec tsx scripts/qa-vis.ts --steps=scripts/qa-vis-cutover.json [--base=https://dim-staging.vercel.app]

steps._why: The flagship. canvas>0 proves maplibre initialised; a 200 with canvas 0 is the clobbered-build signature (BUILD_ID rewritten under a running server: chunks 400, nothing hydrates).

Legend honesty. The ramp must describe the DATA, not the classifier: this view once painted values 1..63 under a legend reading '2 ... 6', on an EXPORTABLE surface. Also checks the k-anon chip is present rather than silently absent.
es-AR thousands separator. A government panel that prints 1507 beside 3.541 reads like two systems talking. 'raw' must be false.

Semaphore honesty. 'Cumplimiento observacion 10d' is painted against a STATUTORY target of 100 (Ord. CABA 41.831 art. 9 / Decreto 4669/1973 PBA). A failing rate must never render in the ok tone. Read the PNG: this one cannot be asserted from text alone.
Anonymous surface. After promotion this is what an unauthenticated citizen hits first, and it is the page that reveals a missing NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL or a broken CSP nonce.
